mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages (channel_id, sender_id, sender_name, content, created_at) VALUES (#{channelId}, #{senderId}, #{senderName}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, channel_id AS channelId, sender_id AS senderId, sender_name AS senderName, content, created_at AS createdAt FROM chat_messages WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 100
